en.title: Short-term rental site AI-agent compliance audit
en.summary: Have Grok Bot audit a short-term rental site for AI-agent friendliness—structured data, schema markup, and whether bots can read and act as guests and search engines expect—then prepare WordPress edits you review.
en.whyItWorks: Agent and search readers need clear structure. Auditing schema and bot accessibility first, then staging edits for human review, keeps the site legible without unsupervised CMS changes.
workflowSteps: Point the bot at your STR site URL and ask for an AI-agent compliance audit focused on structured data and schema.
Collect findings: missing markup, unclear policies, blocked crawlers, weak machine-readable facts (amenities, location, booking).
Tell the bot which WordPress changes to prepare based on the audit.
Review the proposed edit before publishing.
Re-run the audit after deploy to confirm the gaps you cared about are addressed.
en.promptTemplate:
Audit this short-term rental website for AI-agent compliance:
URL: [SITE]

Check:
- Structured data / schema markup presence and gaps
- Whether bots appear welcomed to read key pages
- Clarity of facts guests and search/AI agents need (amenities, location, booking path, policies)

Output: prioritized findings + recommended WordPress edits.
When I approve a fix, prepare the edit text/diff for my review. Do not publish without my confirmation.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Web audit in chat, then review-first WordPress edit prep. Optional monthly routine to re-audit the live URL. Publishing stays manual.

zh.title: 短租网站 AI Agent 合规审计
zh.summary: 让 Grok Bot 审计短租网站对 AI Agent 的友好度——结构化数据、schema，以及机器人是否能按访客与搜索引擎预期阅读与行动——再准备供你审阅的 WordPress 修改。
zh.whyItWorks: Agent 与搜索读者需要清晰结构。先审 schema 与可访问性，再把修改暂存给人审，能提升可读性又避免无人看管的 CMS 改动。
workflowSteps: 把短租站点 URL 交给 Bot，要求做聚焦结构化数据与 schema 的 AI Agent 合规审计。
汇总发现：缺失标记、政策不清、爬虫受阻、机器可读事实不足（设施、位置、预订）。
根据审计结果告诉 Bot 要准备哪些 WordPress 修改。
上线后再跑一遍审计，确认关心的缺口已处理。
zh.promptTemplate:
请审计此短租网站的 AI Agent 合规性：
URL：[SITE]

检查：
- 结构化数据 / schema 是否存在及缺口
- 关键页面是否欢迎机器人读取
- 访客与搜索/AI Agent 需要的事实是否清晰（设施、位置、预订路径、政策）

输出：按优先级排序的发现 + 建议的 WordPress 修改。
我批准某项修复后，准备供审阅的编辑文本/差异。未经确认不得发布。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 对话内网页审计，再以审阅优先方式准备 WordPress 修改。可选每月例行复查线上 URL。发布保持人工。

source.excerpt:
Grok Bot audits my STR website for AI-agent compliance: structured data, schema markup, and whether bots are welcomed to read and act on the site the way guests and search engines expect.

I tell Grok Bot what to change on the WordPress site. It prepares the edit. I review it.
